title: 02. Parse an environment flag

courseHelp.title: Course help
courseHelp.body:
Write your code in the function at the top of the editor. Follow the numbered steps and replace each TODO. Run checks the three examples. Submit checks all cases, including edge cases. Open the hints one at a time if you are stuck.

Keep the adapter class at the bottom unchanged. It reads the input, calls your function, and rejects changes to the input. Python 3.11 and the standard library.

starterCode.python:
TRUE_WORDS = {"true", "1", "yes", "on"}
FALSE_WORDS = {"false", "0", "no", "off"}


def parse_flag(value, default):
    """Turn environment-variable text into True, False, or None.

    parse_flag(' true ', False) -> True
    parse_flag('OFF', True)     -> False
    parse_flag(None, True)      -> True      (not set: use the default)
    parse_flag('enabled', True) -> None      (invalid)
    """
    # Step 1: the variable is not set.
    # TODO: if value is None, return default.

    # Step 2: clean the text: whitespace at both ends, then lowercase.
    text = value  # TODO

    # Step 3: look up the clean text.
    # TODO: return True if text is in TRUE_WORDS.
    # TODO: return False if text is in FALSE_WORDS.

    # Step 4: every other text is invalid.
    return None


# Supplied CoJudge adapter. Implement parse_flag above.
class Solution:
    def run(self, payload: str) -> str:
        import json
        data = json.loads(payload)
        before = json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False)
        result = parse_flag(**data)
        if json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) != before:
            raise ValueError("Do not modify the input objects")
        return json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False)

hints: Never use `bool(value)` on text. Compare the text with known words.
Check `value is None` first. Call string methods only after that check, because `None` has no `.strip()`.
`text = value.strip().lower()`, then `if text in TRUE_WORDS: return True`.
